user.title: Neo Smart Blinds controller
user.description: Add a Neo Smart Blinds controller. Blinds are added afterwards, from the controller's entry.

data_description.host: IP address of the controller, from Your Controllers in the Neo app. Give it a fixed address in your router.
data_description.protocol: HTTP reports errors such as a wrong controller ID; TCP only echoes the command back.
data_description.port: Leave empty for the default: 8838 for HTTP, 8839 for TCP.
data_description.hub_id: The 24 character ID shown under the controller in the Neo app. Required for HTTP.

reauth_confirm.title: Controller ID rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The controller at {host} rejected the controller ID. Enter the ID shown under the controller in the Neo app.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the controller. Check the host, protocol and port.
error.hub_id_required: The controller ID is required for HTTP.

abort.blind_imported: The blind was added to an existing controller.
abort.invalid_protocol: Protocol must be http or tcp.
abort.invalid_blind_code: The blind code must use the format 000.000-00.
abort.invalid_parent_group: The parent group must use the format 000.000-15.

data_description.name: Name shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.blind_code: From the blind's advanced page in the Neo app, for example 021.230-04. Use the room code (channel 15) to control a whole room as one cover.
data_description.motor_code: Shown under the blind code in the Neo app. Required by some controllers (for example C-BR300).
data_description.rail: For top-down/bottom-up blinds; ordinary blinds use the top rail.
data_description.tdbu_extended: Only for top-down/bottom-up blinds with mb, ra, ap or db motors. Uses the u4/d4/x2 command set.
data_description.percent_support: The controller never reports position, so it is always estimated from the close time.
data_description.close_time: Seconds the blind takes to go from fully open to fully closed. Time it with a stopwatch.
data_description.start_position: Position to assume when Home Assistant starts (positioning modes 1 and 2). Leave empty to restore the last known position.
data_description.parent_group: Room code (ending in -15) shared by the blinds in this room. When every blind in the room gets the same command within 250 ms, one room command is sent instead.

error.invalid_motor_code: Motor codes are two letters or digits, for example bf.
error.tdbu_extended_motor: The extended command set only applies to motor codes mb, ra, ap and db.
error.parent_is_blind: The room code must differ from the blind code.
error.position_not_supported: Sending positions needs the top rail, the standard command set and a motor code of no, db, ra, rb, ap, bl, mb or jo. Use mode 2 instead.
error.already_configured: This blind and rail are already set up on this controller.

options.0: 0 - Favourites only: open, close, stop and favourites
options.1: 1 - Send position to the blind (motor must support positions)
options.2: 2 - Emulate position: move up or down, then stop after the calculated time

invalid_hub_id.message: The controller rejected the controller ID. Re-authenticate the integration with the correct ID.

position_not_enabled.message: Positioning mode 0 only accepts 50 (favourite 1) and 51 (favourite 2). Change the blind's positioning mode to use other positions.

yaml_import_failed.title: NeoSmartBlinds YAML blind could not be imported
yaml_import_failed.description: The blind {name} in configuration.yaml could not be imported ({reason}). Fix it in YAML and restart, or add it from the UI, then remove the YAML entry.
